# Ting-Chun Liu (劉庭均)

> Ting-Chun Liu is an artist working at the intersections of critical artificial intelligence, audiovisual media and network practice — dissecting technological systems through feedback-driven interventions.

Areas: Critical artificial intelligence, Generative AI, Artistic research on AI, Media art, Audio-visual performance, Network and internet art, Feedback systems

## Main pages

- [Works](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/): installations, performances, internet art and artistic research
- [About / CV](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/about/): biography, teaching, exhibitions, talks, publications
- [Blog Archive](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/blog/): texts and technical notes (in Mandarin)
- [Audio-Visual Performance](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/performance/)

The site is also available in German (https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/de/) and Traditional Chinese (https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/zh/).

## Works

- [Steering Through the Inner Residue](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/steering-through-the-inner-residue/) (2026): Video Installation
- [Interpolation of the Invisible Color](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/interpolation-of-the-invisible-color/) (2025): Curatorial Practice, Interactive Installation
- [Latent Heat Generation](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/latent-heat-generation/) (2025): Artistic Research
- [Just Jailbreak](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/just-jailbreak/) (2024): Interactive game about jailbreaking a large language model
- [Self-cannibalizing AI](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/self-cannibalizing-ai/) (2023): Talk, 37C3 — Artistic strategies to expose generative text-to-image models
- [Achtung! Verwischung](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/achtung-verwischung/) (2023): Site-Specific Performance
- [Imaginary Landscape](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/imaginary-landscape/) (2022–23): Ongoing Project, Audio-Visual Performance
- [Beneath](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/beneath/) (2022): Sound Installation
- [Sun](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/sun/) (2020): Internet Art (p5.js website)
- [Bring Us Somewhere](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/bring-us-somewhere/) (2020): Video
- [Faces](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/faces/) (2020): Video
- [Segmentary Moonlight](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/segmentary-moonlight/) (2018): Light Installation
- [Message in a Bottle](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/message-in-a-bottle/) (2017): Facebook Posts
- [I kept repeating the unfamiliar self](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/i-kept-repeating-the-unfamiliar-self/) (2017): Video Installation
- [Light Segment](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/light-segment/) (2017): Light Installation
- [Inevitable Cross of The Parallel](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/inevitable-cross-of-the-parallel/) (2017): Performance Record
- [Take Off the Clothes](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/take-off-the-clothes/) (2017): Performance Record
- [Hyper-Link into Image](https://aprilcoffee.github.io/liutingchun/works/hyper-link-into-image/) (2016): Internet Art
